items.html:
Shivil Kaushik is left-arm mystery spinner, with an action similar to Paul Adams'. Kaushik, who does not have a contract with a domestic team, caught the eye of many talent scouts with that whippy action for Hubli Tigers in the Karnataka Premier League. "He's a back-of-the-hand bowler. He himself confesses that he doesn't know which one will turn which way," Hubli's coach Anutosh Poll had said of Kaushik. He was bought for his base price of INR 10 lakhs by Gujarat Lions at the 2016 IPL auction.
ESPNcricinfo staff
